name: Diwash Khanal
bio: I secure modern digital systems by understanding how they are built and where their vulnerabilities lie. Armed with a Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, my main focus is on risk management, threat mitigation, and system resilience. My background in cross-platform software engineering enables me to audit applications from the inside out, making vulnerability assessments and API security testing far more thorough. Furthermore, I integrate machine learning concepts into security workflows, leveraging data-driven models for automated threat detection, log analysis, and proactively defending against evolving risks.
